g.text: Mean score on the 8 datasets with an open-access paper: the PRIDE record and file names already carry most of what an SDRF needs

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b6470

g.text: Same datasets and references in both conditions; the paper is the Methods section and sample legends of the CC-licensed publication. One run per dataset and condition.

g.text: One Haiku + skills run was repeated: the sandbox refused a multi-line command and the model stopped without an SDRF.
